scope: Pending forward/reverse destination acknowledgement after driver death
implementation: Existing handback recognises REFRESH/FINAL pending requests as well as reverse. No added worker or repeated request.

Original live local commander, exact cap issuer/baseline/route/crew guards remain required. Pending request validates original goal, original reply deadline within original recovery hard deadline and original commander pre-request frame. Expiry is checked before ACK.

Only unchanged pre-request commander state or observed MOVE to the recorded goal can wait. Existing cap is confirmed at zero; successful ACK updates commander receipt and removes only request metadata. No hard deadline, anchor, baseline or spent flag changes.
Existing acknowledged reverse stop/rest/goal path or forward crew path then continues on a later existing FSM callback. Changed/expired pending request is terminal rather than replayed.
